title.en: An Act Providing for the Adjustment of Pensions of Public School Teachers and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Adjustment of Pensions of Public School Teachers and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3881_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, any public school teacher who, under the provisions of Act Numbered Three thousand fifty, as amended, and Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred eighty-seven, is entitled to a monthly pension of not exceeding twenty pesos shall hereafter receive a monthly pension of sixty pesos; if he is entitled to a monthly pension of more than twenty pesos, such monthly pension shall be increased by forty pesos.
There is hereby appropriated annually, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such amount as may be necessary to carry into effect the provisions of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
